jq.name: the workflow plugin declares the three collections, four ops and five self-mapped stamps
jq.expr: .manifest.plugins[0].data | (.collections // [] | sort) == ["WfName", "WfNote", "WfScript"] and (.ops // [] | sort) == ["delete", "insert", "query", "update"] and (.stamped // {} | keys) == ["chain_root_doc_id", "job_row_doc_id", "node_did", "session_id", "tool_call_doc_id"] and (.stamped // {} | to_entries | all(.key == .value))
